description: Price gaps across the named bookmakers where the best price for every outcome implies a total probability under 100%. Prematch only, sorted by profitMargin (already a percentage after exchange fees: 2.48 means 2.48%, do not multiply by 100), with stake split (optimalStakes), stake limits (maxStake) and bet links. Prices move fast and bookmakers can void or limit bets, so present results as calculated margins at the quoted prices, never as guaranteed.

allCombinations.description: true returns every bookmaker combination per event, market and line (default: only the best)

bookmakers.description: Comma-separated bookmaker names (e.g. 'Bet365,SingBet'). Every leg uses one of these

includeEventDetails.description: Include teams, date, sport and league for each row

league.description: League slug from get_leagues. Requires sport
